title: Final Power Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the angular distribution of the radiated power as a function of theta and phi.

title: Field Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the correct steps in calculating the magnetic field contributions from each dipole.

title: Summation of Exponentials
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly sum the exponential terms to find the total magnetic field.

title: Comparison of Intensities
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compare the maximum intensity directions for the array and a single dipole correctly.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect handling of sine and cosine terms or missing factors in the final expression.
